svg.title: BunScale app mark
svg.desc: Source artwork for the platform icon set (task 0.22, design.md D0.19). Full-bleed 1024x1024 opaque square with no rounded corners, because iOS applies its own mask; the glyph sits inside the 160 px clear-space inset. Tile, glyph and accent are the exact values of the fixed brand tokens --app-mark-tile, --app-mark-glyph and --app-mark-accent, which resolve through --color-brand-tile/--color-brand-glyph/--color-brand-accent to the --color-orange-700, --color-neutral-0 and --color-orange-200 primitives in src/styles/primitives.css. The hex is inlined because a platform icon is rasterised outside the document and cannot read a CSS custom property. Regenerate with: bun run tauri icon src-tauri/icons/app-mark.svg
